title: SpringWell Launches “Know Your Water Is Just Water” Campaign
summary: SpringWell Launches “Know Your Water Is Just Water” Campaign
body_markdown:
The new campaign from SpringWell Water Filtration, **“Know Your Water Is Just Water,”** is built around a simple but uncomfortable truth: if people knew what was actually in their water, they’d never drink it, cook with it or bathe in it.


SpringWell saw an opportunity to shift the conversation away from filtration technology, ph levels and chemistry jargon to something far more emotional: peace of mind. The result is a new brand platform that reframes whole-home water filtration from an appliance purchase into the confidence of knowing what’s flowing through a home is exactly what it should be…and nothing more.


In addition to the campaign launch, the brand refreshed its[springwellwater.com](http://springwellwater.com/) website, organizing it around how people shop for water filtration. It features a clearer navigation and labeled product tiers across whole home filters, softeners, and reverse osmosis solutions to help consumers find the best product for their home.
